basis: stock at the end of the month
description: M2, end of month (People's Bank of China, via the OECD monetary aggregates dataflow)
method: OECD SDMX DF_MONAGG (SDMX-CSV), one request for every area
notes: Equals the PBoC's published M2 (checked against the PBoC Q3 2026 report in research); the PBoC publishes HTML only.
refresh: history from 2015-01 re-downloaded every run; a failed fetch keeps the previous file
